dashboard.banner.unavailable_text: {known, select, yes {Since {since}: {error}} other {Since an unknown time: {error}}}
dashboard.core.analysis_intro: How well it is working, and what to improve
dashboard.core.analysis_model: Your house, as CA has learned it
dashboard.core.analysis_pa_sub: How well each prediction engine guessed this home: its past predictions next to what the sensor then read. The main engine (Settings, Prediction engine) times Climate Advisor’s decisions; the comparison engine only draws a line.
dashboard.core.briefing_regenerate_title: Refreshes the plan shown here. It does not send a push or email notification.
dashboard.core.briefing_send_title: Sends today's briefing as a notification
dashboard.core.chart_activity_label: Heating, cooling, fan, ventilation and window activity over time
dashboard.core.chart_ahead_label: Ahead: how much forecast to show
dashboard.core.chart_empty: No chart data yet. The chart fills in as Climate Advisor logs readings.
dashboard.core.chart_indoor_label: Indoor temperature by sensor with predictions
dashboard.core.chart_outdoor_label: Outdoor temperature: sensor, weather service forecast and corrected forecast
dashboard.core.chart_past_label: Past: how much history to show
dashboard.core.chart_stack_label: Temperature chart. Left and right arrows move a readout along the time axis; Escape clears it. Table view lists the same values.
dashboard.core.debug_filter_placeholder: Filter every field by name or value...
dashboard.core.debug_foot: Every automation-state field is listed once, in its group. Download diagnostics has the full raw data. Daily records and promises moved to Analysis.
dashboard.core.gh_not_configured: GitHub integration is not configured. Add your token and repository in Home Assistant, Settings, Devices & services, Climate Advisor, Configure, GitHub integration.
dashboard.core.health_line: {health, select, ok {Healthy} other {Unavailable}}{version, select, none {} other { · v{version}}} · automation {automation, select, on {on} other {off}}
dashboard.core.plan_sub: What Climate Advisor will do, and what you are asked to do. The same steps are marked on the chart.
dashboard.core.report_ai_disabled: AI features are not configured. Enable them in Settings → AI.
dashboard.core.report_choose: Choose a report type and press Generate.
dashboard.core.report_deep: Deep investigation (also include config, known fixes, version history, GitHub issues)
dashboard.core.settings_foot: These are the current settings. They are read-only here; use Change in Home Assistant to edit them.
dashboard.core.starting_retry: Climate Advisor is starting. This page keeps trying every minute.
dashboard.night.act_fan_off_predicted: Turn the fan off once the bedroom reaches the target (about this time)
dashboard.night.act_fan_on_predicted: Turn the fan on once the bedroom reaches the target (about this time)
dashboard.night.act_through_night: Leave the windows open until you wake, then close them
dashboard.night.act_windows_close_predic: Close the windows once the bedroom reaches the target (about this time)
dashboard.night.act_windows_open_predict: Open the windows once the bedroom reaches the target (about this time)
dashboard.night.chart_label: Predicted bedroom temperature for each strategy
dashboard.night.chart_label_best: Predicted bedroom temperature for each strategy. Best: {label}, {lo} to {hi} degrees
dashboard.night.no_numbers: Predicted bedroom temperatures are not shown yet. Climate Advisor shows them once its bedroom model has learned enough about your bedroom.
dashboard.night.score_note: Score = degree-hours outside the sleep band beyond the thermostat swing + hours of HVAC. Lowest wins; ties go to fewer things for you to do.
dashboard.night.steps_none: Nothing for you to do: keep the windows closed and let Climate Advisor hold the sleep band.
dashboard.night.summary: Bedroom {lo}–{hi}° against a {floor}–{ceiling}° sleep band; {minutes, plural, one {# min} other {# min}} of HVAC.
dashboard.night.tag_steps: {n, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} for you
dashboard.status.briefing_failed: The briefing could not be loaded: {error}
dashboard.status.contact_not_responding: {name} not responding: last read {last}, treated as {treated}
dashboard.status.corrected_title: The weather service’s forecast as Climate Advisor corrects it: it starts from your outdoor sensor’s reading and lets this gap fade over the next few hours (plus what it has learned about the service’s usual miss at each hour).
dashboard.status.fan_remote_speed: The remote set the fan speed to {speed}
dashboard.status.fan_timer: Fan timer from the remote: {hours} h
dashboard.status.fan_timer_ends: Fan timer from the remote: {hours} h, ends {time}
dashboard.status.fan_unmanaged: {name} is not managed by Climate Advisor{rest}
dashboard.status.night_load_failed: The night plan could not be loaded.
dashboard.status.night_load_failed_why: The night plan could not be loaded: {error}
dashboard.status.night_none: No night plan yet. It appears once Climate Advisor has classified today.
dashboard.status.night_none_day: Tonight's plan appears 6 hours before bedtime.

dashboard.status.outdoor_vs_service_titl: The weather service’s figure for this hour against what your outdoor sensor reads now: a gap between two readings, not a temperature.

dashboard.status.trend_same: Tomorrow about the same as today
